## Considering missing observations

Clinical data sets are (almost guaranteed) never complete. Understanding the missingness within the data is keay to asserting which conclusions can be drawn from the collected data. The ***FreesearchR*** app includes key tools to evaluating missing observations in the data set. A more in-depth instructional video is beeing worked on. Until that is ready, have a look below for links to further reading.

### Further reading

The authors behind the [{finalfit}-package](https://finalfit.org/index.html) have shared a very comprehensive article on what to do and think about missing observations in your data. Please [have a look here](https://finalfit.org/articles/missing.html).
